subject: Next steps & procurement path for Cloudware pilot
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Rao <asha.rao@cloudware.io>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-01T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps & procurement path for Cloudware pilot

Hi Asha — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on procurement and timeline:

Call recap (30-min discovery):
- Primary use case: customer support answer generation + internal knowledge surfacing (pilot, ~250 agents).
- Success criteria: 30% latency reduction vs current endpoint and < $0.02/1000 tokens in pilot economics.
- Privacy note: data stays in VPC; Cloudware asked about KMS and audit logs. We support both in Private and Dedicated plans.

Procurement / commercial path options we discussed:
1) Marketplace procurement (recommended for speed): single sign-on billing, faster onboarding, standard T&Cs.
2) Standard PO / vendor onboarding: we can accept Net30 or Net45; PO needed for accounts payable.
3) Card payment for pilot (small pilots only) — fastest but not always allowed for enterprise procurement.

Requested from Cloudware to move things forward:
- Who owns procurement & vendor onboarding at Cloudware (name/email)?
- Do you prefer Marketplace or PO? Any internal timelines (e.g., procurement meeting cadence)?
- Any legal or security docs you need (SOC 2 type II, data maps)?

Proposed immediate next steps:
- I attach a short proposal + SOW template to kick off the paperwork (proposal_v1.pdf, SOW-template.docx).
- If Marketplace is acceptable, I’ll open the listing request and share the procurement link.
- Offer: I can join a procurement intro call with your procurement lead + Sean for technical/ops questions.

Can you share the procurement contact so we can route the right packet? If you prefer, we can also do a 20-min call this week.

Thanks,

—Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: proposal_v1.pdf, SOW-template.docx
From: Asha Rao <asha.rao@cloudware.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-03T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps & procurement path for Cloudware pilot

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. This is very helpful.

A few quick answers and questions from procurement side:
- Procurement owner: Samir Patel (samir.p@cloudware.io) handles vendor onboarding and PO workflows. I’m looping him in on the next email.
- Preference: Cloudware prefers a PO for anything that will be invoiced to the platform. Marketplace would be ideal if the vendor is listed and allows us to avoid vendor onboarding.
- Timeline: Our next vendor committee meets on 3/18 — if paperwork is in by 3/12 we can make the 3/18 cadence.
- Terms: We typically run Net30. Any objections? Also confirm whether Redwood does DocuSign for SOWs.

Two items we need from you before Samir will start the onboarding packet:
1) Standard vendor onboarding form completed (I’ve attached a blank copy we use; we’ll confirm required fields).
2) A short call (15–20m) with Samir to walk through technical controls (KMS, audit logs) and commercial options.

A note on insurance and SOC: we’ll want SOC 2 Type II and current certs (happy to accept a link).

Thanks — looping Samir now.

Best,
Asha
Director, Product Operations | Cloudware Inc
asha.rao@cloudware.io

Hi Samir / Asha — thanks for the quick reply and for sharing your timeline. Looping Sean (solutions engineering) to help with the technical packet on KMS/audit logs and to join the procurement call.

Quick proposed routes based on what you told us:
- Fastest: Marketplace listing. If Cloudware can buy via a marketplace (AWS/GCP/Azure or your corporate marketplace), we can often complete onboarding in 3–5 business days. I can initiate the marketplace request today and share the billing link.
- PO route: Typical onboarding + vendor approval is 2–3 weeks (depends on committee). Since your vendor committee meets 3/18, getting the packet in by 3/12 is a good target.
- Card: If legal approves, we can accept card for the pilot to speed things up, then convert to PO for production.

Attachments I’m including: marketplace-playbook.pdf (explains steps and sample timelines) and a filled vendor packet with the high-level answers to fields you’ll likely ask for. If you prefer, Sean and I can do a 20-min intro with Samir tomorrow or Friday.

Proposed times for a short procurement intro call:
- Thu 3/5 10:00–10:30 PT
- Fri 3/6 09:00–09:30 PT
- Fri 3/6 15:00–15:30 PT

If none of those work, share two times that do and we’ll accommodate.

Thanks — happy to move whichever lane you prefer.

—Marissa
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Hi Marissa / Sean — quick weekly check-in. Wanted to see where this is currently stuck on our side so I can escalate internally if helpful. Current status here: 
- I submitted the vendor packet to Samir on 3/4. Samir is reviewing but mentioned the legal team needs one clarification on the indemnity language in the SOW.
- Marketplace: procurement confirmed Cloudware would prefer marketplace if Redwood is available, but procurement needs Redwood to be listed or provide the marketplace vendor ID.
- Timeline: I’m aiming to have the paperwork ready for the 3/18 vendor committee — if any documents or clarifications are missing please flag now.

Can you provide the following so I can push internally?
1) Updated SOW with the minimal indemnity tweak (or confirmation you can accept our standard language).
2) Marketplace vendor ID or the marketplace request contact so I can fast-track listing.
3) Any items legal will need (SOC 2 link, insurance cert).

If it helps, we’re happy to do a short triangle call (legal + Samir + Redwood) to resolve the indemnity item quickly.

Thanks — appreciate the help and want to keep this moving.

Best,
Asha
